instructions.name: close_strategy
docs: Close a Pending or Closed strategy and reclaim rent.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Receives the reclaimed rent lamports.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: PotBot treasury (YD's wallet receives SNS fee)

instructions.name: create_strategy
docs: Create a strategy slot (SL/TP/trailing + optional yield leg).
Entry swap happens separately via execute_swap.

accounts.name: pot
docs: Parent pot. Must match `args.source` (e.g. pot.authority for AdminDirect).

accounts.name: authority
docs: The member whose role authorizes creation. For AdminDirect path this
must equal `pot.authority` or have Role::Admin in MemberPermissions.
Checked manually in the handler to keep the constraint flexible
across source variants.

instructions.name: execute_swap
docs: Execute a Jupiter v6 swap on behalf of a pot vault.
Three auth modes: AdminDirect | Proposal | StrategyTrigger.

accounts.name: pot
docs: Parent pot. Authority / agent_authority are validated dynamically
inside `authorize_mode` — we can't bind via `has_one` here because
the required signer varies by mode.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Asset ownership is validated via source_ata / destination_ata.owner below.

accounts.name: pyth_price_update
docs: For AdminDirect / Proposal modes this may be the program id as a
sentinel (we never read it in those modes).

accounts.name: proposal_swap_spec
docs: Optional ProposalSwapSpec PDA. REQUIRED when `mode == Proposal`; the
handler enforces presence + match of spec.proposal_id, spec.passed,
spec.input_mint/output_mint, spec.max_in/min_out. Absent for the
AdminDirect and StrategyTrigger paths.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Signer interpretation:
AdminDirect      → must equal pot.authority
Proposal         → must equal pot.authority (Phase 2: or Member NFT)
StrategyTrigger  → must equal pot.agent_authority

instructions.name: mark_proposal_passed
docs: Mark a Proposal-sourced strategy as passed (admin-only, idempotent).
Sets strategy.proposal_passed = true, enabling execute_swap(Proposal).

accounts.name: proposal_swap_spec
docs: The ProposalSwapSpec PDA attached to this strategy's proposal.
Must match the proposal_id encoded in strategy.source.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Must be pot.authority. Agent authority NOT accepted here.

instructions.name: pause_pot
docs: Emergency pause — blocks all execute_swap calls on this pot.

instructions.name: register_delegate
docs: Register (or re-register) a delegate wallet that may sign votes for this
member. `rules_uri` is an off-chain URI describing the delegate's
voting policy — purely for transparency, not enforced on-chain.

accounts.name: member
docs: The caller must be a member of this pot with non-zero shares.

accounts.name: delegate_account
docs: PDA: [b"delegate", pot, member_wallet]

instructions.name: revoke_delegate
docs: Revoke an existing delegation. The PDA is preserved (not closed) so the
audit trail remains visible on-chain.

instructions.name: set_allowed_mints
docs: Set the mint allowlist and keeper agent authority for this pot.

instructions.name: set_spending_policy
docs: Configure per-swap size cap and daily budget.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: PotBot treasury (YD's wallet receives tokenization fee)

instructions.name: unpause_pot
docs: Resume a paused pot.

accounts.name: voter_record
docs: VoterRecord PDA — `init` (NOT init_if_needed) means tx fails if already exists.
This is the on-chain double-vote prevention mechanism.

instructions.name: vote_as_delegate
docs: Vote on a proposal as a registered delegate (e.g. an AI agent) on behalf
of a member. Vote weight comes from member.shares; double-vote prevented
because VoterRecord is keyed by member.wallet (not delegate.delegate).

accounts.name: delegate_account
docs: Active delegate registration: signer must equal `delegate.delegate`,
`revoked_at == 0`, `pot` matches.

accounts.name: voter_record
docs: VoterRecord PDA — keyed by member.wallet (NOT delegate_signer.key).
`init` (not `init_if_needed`) → fails if the member or any prior
delegate already voted on this proposal. Same double-vote prevention
as the original `vote` instruction.

fields.name: timelock_seconds
docs: Delay (seconds) between proposal passing and execution. 0 = instant.
Recommended: 0 for autocracy, 3600-86400 for democracy.

fields.name: amount_in
docs: Amount of input token intended to spend.

fields.name: min_out
docs: Minimum acceptable output — hard floor enforced on-chain.

fields.name: max_in
docs: Absolute ceiling on input consumed (defense-in-depth; normally == amount_in).

fields.name: is_entry
docs: Entry (Pending→Active) or exit (Active/Parked→Closed).

fields.name: jupiter_ix_data
docs: Raw Jupiter v6 swap instruction data from `/swap-instructions`.

fields.name: pot
docs: The POT this member belongs to

fields.name: wallet
docs: Member's wallet

fields.name: shares
docs: Share units owned

fields.name: deposit_total
docs: Total deposited (for P&L tracking)

fields.name: withdraw_total
docs: Total withdrawn (for P&L tracking)

fields.name: joined_at
docs: When the member joined

fields.name: last_deposit_at
docs: Last deposit timestamp (for lockup enforcement)

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed

types.name: MemberDelegate
docs: Allows a member to register a delegate wallet (typically an AI agent)
that can sign votes on the member's behalf without holding their main key.
PDA: [b"delegate", pot_pubkey, member_wallet_pubkey]
One delegate per (pot, member). Re-registering replaces the previous one.
Revocation sets `revoked_at` (the account is kept for audit trail).

fields.name: pot
docs: The POT this delegation applies to

fields.name: member
docs: The member's wallet (the account whose voting power is delegated)

fields.name: delegate
docs: The delegate's wallet (the AI agent that may sign votes)

fields.name: rules_uri
docs: IPFS / Arweave / https URI describing the agent's voting policy.
On-chain program does NOT enforce this — it's a transparency artefact
that lets other members audit the AI's behaviour and revoke if needed.

fields.name: scope_mask
docs: Bitmask of proposal-type indices the delegate is allowed to vote on.
0 means "all proposal types" (default for v1).
Reserved for future per-type scoping.

fields.name: registered_at
docs: Unix timestamp when the delegation was registered or last updated.

fields.name: revoked_at
docs: Unix timestamp when the delegation was revoked. 0 = active.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump

fields.name: agent_pubkey
docs: Pubkey used for rate-limiting agent proposals (legacy field).

fields.name: paused
docs: Emergency pause. When true, execute_swap rejects all modes.

fields.name: agent_authority
docs: Keeper agent authority for StrategyTrigger mode.
This is the keeper's hot wallet pubkey — separate from agent_pubkey.
Set via set_allowed_mints.

fields.name: allowed_mints
docs: Mint allowlist for swap strategies (zeroed entries = unused slots).
Maximum 16 mints per pot.

fields.name: allowed_mints_count
docs: Number of populated entries in allowed_mints.

fields.name: daily_budget_lamports
docs: Maximum lamports spendable per UTC day across all strategies.
0 = unlimited (not recommended for production).

fields.name: daily_spent_lamports
docs: Lamports spent in the current UTC day (resets at midnight).

fields.name: daily_spend_day
docs: UTC day number (unix_timestamp / 86400) of the last spend.

fields.name: single_swap_cap_bps
docs: Maximum single swap as bps of vault balance (0 = unlimited).
E.g. 2000 = 20% of vault per swap.

fields.name: strategy_count
docs: Monotonic count of StrategyAccount PDAs created under this pot.

fields.name: fee_reserve
docs: Keeper gas reserve (lamports). Keeper draws from this for trigger gas.

fields.name: passed_at
docs: Timestamp when proposal transitioned to Passed — used for timelock enforcement.
0 if not yet passed.

fields.name: max_in
docs: Maximum input the executor may spend. Enforced on-chain: spent ≤ max_in.

fields.name: min_out
docs: Minimum output the executor must receive. Enforced: received ≥ min_out.

fields.name: slippage_bps
docs: Maximum slippage in bps for the Jupiter route (defence-in-depth).

fields.name: price_feed_id
docs: Optional Pyth feed id — if set, execute_swap verifies execution price
is within oracle_deviation_bps of the oracle mid at execution time.

fields.name: passed
docs: Set to true by mark_proposal_passed. Required by execute_swap(Proposal).

fields.name: executed
docs: Set to true by execute_swap(Proposal). Prevents double execution.

fields.name: mints
docs: Up to 16 mints. Pass empty slice to clear the allowlist (open mode).

fields.name: agent_authority
docs: Keeper agent authority for StrategyTrigger mode.

fields.name: single_swap_cap_bps
docs: Max single swap as bps of vault balance (0 = unlimited).

fields.name: daily_budget_lamports
docs: Max lamports per UTC day across all strategies (0 = unlimited).

fields.name: pot
docs: Associated pot

fields.name: domain_name
docs: Domain name (e.g., "mypot")

fields.name: full_domain
docs: Full domain (e.g., "mypot.potbot.sol")

fields.name: created_at
docs: Creation timestamp

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump

fields.name: size_in
docs: Actual input spent (filled on entry swap).

fields.name: size_out
docs: Actual output received (filled on entry swap).

fields.name: entry_price_x64
docs: Entry price in Q64.64 fixed-point (size_out / size_in * 2^64).

fields.name: trailing_high_price_x64
docs: Latest observed price for trailing-stop math.

fields.name: pyth_price_feed
docs: Pyth price feed account. None = keeper-trusted mode.

fields.name: yield_position
docs: Live record of the current yield deposit. None in spot.

fields.name: executor_nonce
docs: Incremented on every successful execute_swap. Prevents replay.

fields.name: proposal_passed
docs: For Proposal-sourced strategies: set to true by mark_proposal_passed.
execute_swap(Proposal) requires this to be true.

fields.name: last_price_update_ts
docs: Last publish_time consumed from Pyth (for UI "last priced N min ago").

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved for forward compatibility.

types.name: StrategySource
docs: Who authored the strategy. Determines auth path in execute_swap.

fields.name: pot
docs: Associated pot

fields.name: mint
docs: NFT mint address

fields.name: owner
docs: Owner wallet (soulbound to this address)

fields.name: level
docs: Current tamagotchi level (0-5)

fields.name: xp
docs: Current XP

fields.name: created_at
docs: Creation timestamp

fields.name: last_evolved_at
docs: Last evolution timestamp

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump

types.name: TriggerReason
docs: Reason a keeper-submitted trigger fired.

types.name: VoterRecord
docs: Tracks that a specific wallet has already voted on a specific proposal.
PDA: [b"voter", proposal_pubkey, voter_pubkey]
Using `init` (not `init_if_needed`) means the tx fails if this already exists —
which is exactly the double-vote prevention mechanism.

fields.name: proposal
docs: The proposal this vote is for

fields.name: voter
docs: The voter's wallet

fields.name: voted_yes
docs: Whether they voted YES (true) or NO (false)

fields.name: voted_at
docs: Timestamp of vote

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump

types.name: YieldPosition
docs: Concrete record of the strategy's current yield deposit.
None while the strategy is in spot (Pending/Active/Closed).
Set by route_to_yield, cleared by unwrap_yield.

types.name: YieldTarget
docs: Where idle capital is parked between entry and exit.
